title: Zesty Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken curry dish with a zesty twist, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil.
Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the curry powder to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the zesty curry sauce, water, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine and bring the sauce to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
